tools.name: search_sandals_resorts

tools.name: search_beaches_resorts
tools.description: Search Beaches Resorts (family all-inclusive). Resort names and booking URLs are read live from beaches.com.

tools.name: get_resort_booking_url

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_agency_info" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get Pixie Vacations credentials, awards, and booking options.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_sandals_resorts, search_beaches_resorts, get_resort_booking_url, get_sandals_beaches_deals, search_virgin_voyages · Private data: get_agency_info · Public sink: request_pixie_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_sandals_resorts, search_beaches_resorts, get_resort_booking_url, get_sandals_beaches_deals, search_virgin_voyages · Private data: get_agency_info · Public sink: request_pixie_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_sandals_resorts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search all 17 Sandals Resorts. Returns co-branded URLs (referral=135752). Use when user wants a Sandals resort." → after: "Search Sandals Resorts (couples, adults-only). Resort names and booking URLs are read live from sandals.com, so they reflect the October 2026 renames. Use when the user wants a Sandals resort."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
